2026 General Election Official Candidate List
*This list is official and reflects what was certified to the counties on September 4.
*A candidate’s name that is stricken through has withdrawn.
*Certified write in candidates are not listed on the ballot; however, voters may write the candidate’s name on the ballot in the appropriate space provided in order to cast a vote for that candidate.
